crossRefs.note: Joshua said to the people, “You are witnesses against yourselves that you have chosen Yahweh yourselves, to serve him.”…
For your iniquity teaches your mouth, and you choose the language of the crafty.
Your own mouth condemns you, and not I. Yes, your own lips testify against you.
Their own tongues shall ruin them. All who see them will shake their heads.
“He said to him, ‘Out of your own mouth I will judge you, you wicked servant! You knew that I am an exacting man…
“You stiff-necked and uncircumcised in heart and ears, you always resist the Holy Spirit! As your fathers did, so you…
Which of the prophets didn’t your fathers persecute? They killed those who foretold the coming of the Righteous One, of…
who killed both the Lord Jesus and their own prophets, and drove us out, and don’t please God, and are contrary to all…
forbidding us to speak to the Gentiles that they may be saved, to fill up their sins always. But wrath has come on them…

translations.web: Therefore you testify to yourselves that you are children of those who killed the prophets.
translations.bsb: So you testify against yourselves that you are the sons of those who murdered the prophets.
translations.kjv: Wherefore ye be witnesses unto yourselves, that ye are the children of them which killed the prophets.
translations.asv: Wherefore ye witness to yourselves, that ye are sons of them that slew the prophets.
